description: Create a reusable session for browser-state continuity across related tasks. Use this before multiple runs that should share login state, defaults, or recent context.

agent_kind.description: Optional default planner backend for the session.

agent_model.description: Optional default planner model for the session. Auto, PI, and OpenCode use the catalog-backed selection when set. Defaults to openai/gpt-5.3-codex-spark.

agent_variant.description: Optional default planner thinking variant for the session. Defaults to high for catalog-backed planners.

mode.description: Session mode: guest for reusable browser state, profile for a named bound profile.

notes.description: Optional operator notes for the session.

profile.description: Optional bound browser profile for profile-mode sessions.

start_url.description: Optional default start URL for later tasks in this session.

name: webtask_create_session
title: Create Web Session
